mostWorthwhile.text: Harvesting the potatoes was the strongest payoff: the planted seed pieces became a substantial meal after the farm survived the storm.

leastWorthwhile.text: Putting the soaked beans in the pot was clear but a fairly routine intermediate step.

surprise.text: I expected harvesting potatoes to leave more preparation, but the result included washing and cutting them too.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the separate cooking stages had a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. The grounded meal was satisfying, and I would like to see how the specimens and return journey resolve.
